description: Decision records for the subscription billing context. Deliberately flawed: 0002 is superseded by a record that does not exist, 0005 claims to supersede 0002, 0003 is missing, 0004 is used twice, one 0004 has an invalid status, a non-ISO date and no Decision section.

files.0001-bill-in-arrears-per-subscription.md:
# 0001. Invoice each Subscription in arrears, one Invoice per billing period

**Status:** accepted
**Date:** 2026-03-02
**Deciders:** Billing product lead, Payments engineering

## Context
Customers with several Subscriptions asked for one combined Invoice. Combining them
ties unrelated renewal dates together and makes proration across Plans ambiguous.

## Decision
We will issue one Invoice per Subscription per billing period, after the period ends.
Combined statements, if wanted later, are a read-only summary, not an Invoice.

## Alternatives considered
- One combined Invoice per Customer per month: rejected, forces aligned renewal dates.
- Invoicing in advance: rejected, refunds on Cancellation become routine.

## Consequences
Customers with many Subscriptions receive many Invoices. Proration stays local to one Subscription.
files.0002-retry-failed-charges-nightly.md:
# 0002. Retry failed Charges in a nightly batch

**Status:** superseded by 0006
**Date:** 2026-04-11

## Context
Failed Charges were retried immediately, which hit gateway rate limits.

## Decision
We will retry failed Charges once per night for three nights.

## Consequences
Recovery takes up to three days.
files.0004-pause-shifts-renewal-date.md:
# 0004. A pause shifts the renewal date

**Status:** done
**Date:** 14/05/2026

## Context
Customers want to pause instead of cancel. Finance does not want zero-value Invoices.

## Discussion
Pause could produce zero Invoices, or shift the renewal date. Most people preferred shifting.
files.0004-grace-period-before-suspension.md:
# 0004. Seven-day grace period before suspension

**Status:** proposed
**Date:** 2026-05-20

## Context
A single failed Charge currently suspends access immediately.

## Decision
Access continues for a seven-day grace period after a failed Charge.

## Consequences
Some unpaid usage is written off.
files.0005-use-the-word-subscription-everywher:
# 0005. Rename membership to Subscription in code, docs and support macros

**Status:** accepted
**Supersedes:** 0002
**Date:** 2026-06-01

## Context
Support, sales and code used membership, contract and subscription for the same concept,
and two incidents came from a membership flag that meant something narrower.

## Decision
We use Subscription as the only name. Identifiers are renamed as files are touched;
support macros are renamed in one batch.

## Options considered
- Keep membership in support only: rejected, tickets are copied into engineering issues verbatim.

## Consequences
A long tail of identifiers keeps the old name until the files are next edited.
